content:
lina: Heads up, retention policy change incoming. We need a short intake form + RBAC template for any SIEM export beyond 90d. Keep it lightweight.

omar: Agreed. Minimal fields: requester, incident id, time range, indices, purpose, sensitivity flag, approver. Auto-expire date required.

rafi: For RBAC, propose a short-lived role `temp:siem-export` that requires a ticket-tag on AssumeRole and has max session 8h. Tag must include ticket id and expires_at.

eng-iam-bot: NOTE: policy engine can enforce aws:RequestTag and aws:TagKeys checks. We can add condition to deny if expires_at > ticket-approved-end.

lina: KMS unwraps must be logged to audit stream. If CMK rotation happens, enforce pre-rotation snapshot or record wrapped key version.

legal: Add DPIA check if sensitive EU data. Also require a statement that data minimization was performed.

omar: Automation: approved ticket should trigger s3 bucket creation with lifecycle rule to auto-delete on expires_at and push audit event with hash of exported bundle. Block exports >20GB unless seclead approves.

rafi: I'll open a short RFC for eng-iam and infra with the ticket template and policy snippets. Keeping the intake form to one page will help adoption.

lina: Perfect. Please cc me and legal on the RFC. We'll aim to include this in the retention playbook and announce to SREs. :white_check_mark:
